intro.h2: Tile work that lines up, from the prep to the last row
paragraphs: Tile Envy Installation Co focuses on custom tile shower installation and bathroom remodels in La Porte, IN. One of our own Facebook posts sums up how we see it: the prep work is where a quality shower starts. A fellow tile professional recommends AJ and Tile Envy for exactly that, citing our attention to detail and dedication to proper industry methods.

Homeowners see the difference in the finished room. One family hired us to gut and remodel the main bath of a house they had just bought, taking down a wall to join two small rooms into one large space. They are still amazed at how perfectly every tile lines up. Another customer says AJ kept them informed through the whole process.

services.h2: Custom tile shower installation and more

items.name: Custom tile showers
items.blurb: We build walk-in tile showers from the prep up: walls, floor, niches and benches. The shower shown here pairs tall white wave-textured wall tile with a black hexagon floor, a recessed niche, a long bench and a black rain head behind a sliding glass door.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with white wave-textured wall tile, black hexagon floor, recessed niche and long bench

items.name: Full bathroom remodels
items.blurb: We take on whole bathrooms, not only the shower. One main bath started with a full gut and a wall coming down to make two rooms into one. Finished rooms on our Google profile show a white double vanity, black fixtures and dark plank flooring around the new tile.

image.alt: Remodeled bathroom with a white shaker double vanity, black faucets and mirrors, and dark plank flooring

items.name: Decorative tile and accents
items.blurb: Details are what make people stop and look. Our photos show marble-look walls with a framed mosaic panel, a patterned border wrapping a tub deck and stacked shower niches. Bring an accent idea and we will talk through where it fits and how it lines up.

image.alt: Marble-look tile shower with a framed mosaic panel, two stacked niches and oil-rubbed bronze body sprays

items.name: Shower and bath upgrades
items.blurb: Not ready for a full gut? We also upgrade tired showers and baths. One customer says AJ did a fantastic job bringing her shower and bathroom back to life. The shower here got glossy charcoal subway tile on the walls and a classic black and white mosaic floor.

image.alt: Shower with glossy charcoal subway tile walls and a black and white octagon mosaic floor behind a glass panel

items.name: Kitchen backsplashes
items.blurb: Backsplashes come up in several of our Google reviews. Whether you want classic subway tile, a mosaic or something bolder behind the range, we bring the same care for straight grout lines and clean cuts to the wall above your counters.

about.text: Tile Envy Installation Co is a tile contractor that builds custom showers and remodels bathrooms. AJ is the name our customers mention most: he kept one family informed from start to finish, and a fellow tile installer recommends him by name. Our team handles everything from demolition to the final row of tile, including big changes like removing a wall to turn two rooms into one main bath. We believe a quality shower starts with the prep you never see. Call us Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM.

process.h2: How a Tile Envy project goes

steps.title: Call us
steps.text: Call (219) 216-4896, Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM, and tell us about your shower, bathroom or backsplash.

steps.title: Plan the layout and tile
steps.text: We talk through layout and tile choices with you. Tile selection comes up in our reviews, so bring photos of looks you like.

steps.title: Prep comes first
steps.text: Demolition and prep happen before any tile goes up, because the prep work is where a quality shower starts.

steps.title: Set the tile
steps.text: Tile goes in with care for straight lines and clean cuts, and we keep you informed as the job moves along.

steps.title: Walk the finished room
steps.text: We go over the finished space with you, so you can check every line, niche and edge before we wrap up.

service_area.h2: Custom tile shower installation in La Porte, IN
service_area.text: Tile Envy Installation Co serves La Porte, IN. If your home is nearby but outside town, the quickest way to check is a phone call. Reach us at (219) 216-4896, Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM, tell us where you live and what you want done, whether a new shower, a full bathroom or a backsplash, and we will let you know.

items.q: What kind of tile work do you do?
items.a: We build custom walk-in tile showers, remodel full bathrooms and upgrade existing showers and baths. We also install kitchen backsplashes and decorative accents such as mosaic panels, borders and shower niches. Our reviews mention tile selection, backsplashes and attention to detail more than anything else.

items.q: Can you handle a full bathroom remodel, not just the tile?
items.a: Yes. One homeowner hired us for a full main bath gut and remodel in a house they had just purchased. We tore down a wall to make two separate rooms into one large space, and they say we took the worst room in the house and turned it into their favorite.

items.q: How long will my project take?
items.a: It depends on the size of the job, and we will give you an estimate before we start. We would rather be honest than rushed: on one large remodel the work took a little longer than first estimated, and the homeowner said you can't rush perfection. Call us to talk through your timeline.

items.q: Can you help me choose tile?
items.a: Yes. Tile selection is one of the topics customers mention in our Google reviews. Bring photos of showers or backsplashes you like, along with your room measurements if you have them, and we will help you narrow down tile, layout and accents that suit the space.

We are open Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call (219) 216-4896 to talk with us about a shower, bathroom or backsplash project, or send a message through our Facebook page with a few photos of the space.
